title: I Took the Sauna-Locker Pin to the Desk That Issued Two to Friends

parts.text: I took the sauna-locker pin at 7:19 p.m. to the desk that issued two to friends. The board said ONE PIN PER WRISTBAND. I was thirty-one, member, standing at a desk that made me look like I owned the wait. I photographed the two pins, the wristbands, and the board. The desk voided the extras and dated the log. I keep the two-pin photo. The sauna finally knows a wristband from a friend.
